name: Naenia
source:
The World Tree was almost completely withered. The world was close to its ending. Many people came to a certain place, the funeral parlor, in order to seek 'salvation' from the Funeral Princess.

[From [url=https://altila.itch.io/naenia]itch.io[/url]]
